context: Tabby messaged all 16 batch-1 sellers; none replied. Sub-฿8k FB Marketplace personal sellers in Bangkok have low reply rates. Batch 2 widens to Kaidee + biases toward listings with shop signals (warranty, bulk inventory, verified seller badges).

ranking_criteria: shop_signal: explicit warranty / bulk inventory / verified-seller badge / 'ร้าน' / '8 เครื่อง' (responds to messages)
spec_match: 16GB RAM, ≥13.3" screen, modern CPU (Gen 8+), business-class chassis preferred
bangkok_metro: BKK / Nonthaburi / Pathum Thani / Samut Prakan = pickup-friendly

picks.title: Acer TravelMate P214-53 i5-1135G7 16GB 1TB SSD 14"
picks.shop_signal: BULK_RESELLER — 'ขายังเหมา 8 เครื่อง' (selling in batch of 8) = IT shop with stock, will reply
picks.why: TravelMate is Acer's business line (matches Latitude/ThinkPad class). Gen 11 + 16GB + huge 1TB SSD at ฿6,500 is excellent value. Bulk-stock seller = reply rate near 100%.
picks.risk: verify it's the same exact unit (8 in stock means rotation — confirm CPU + battery health on the specific one shipped)

picks.title: Dell Latitude 7320 i5 Gen 11 16GB 256GB SSD 13.3" FHD
picks.shop_signal: PRICE_CUT — listing has crossed-out ฿7,900 → ฿6,900 (active seller adjusting price to move)
picks.why: Latitude 7000 series is Dell's premium business ultrabook — Gen 11 + 16GB + FHD at ฿6,900 is the spec leader of this batch. Replaces ghosted batch-1 #1 pick (Latitude 7420) at ฿300 less.
picks.risk: Ban Rakat is Yala province (~1,000km from BKK) — must ship; pickup not feasible. Validate seller will ship & accept COD.

picks.title: Asus Gaming i7 16GB GTX dGPU SSD M.2 (new battery + 6-month warranty)
picks.shop_signal: WARRANTY — 'แบตใหม่ ประกัน 6 เดือน' (new battery + 6-month warranty) = professional reseller
picks.why: Only listing in entire pool offering warranty AND new battery for under ฿6k. Gaming chassis but spec-strong: i7 + 16GB + GTX dGPU. Perfect if Tabby occasionally wants more than thin-client.
picks.risk: gaming = heavier (~2.3kg) and lower battery life vs business ultrabook. Get exact model + CPU gen before committing.

picks.title: Dell Latitude 3410 i5-10210U 16GB 256GB SSD 14" Wi-Fi6
picks.shop_signal: KAIDEE_PLATFORM — Kaidee sellers reply faster than FB (LINE/phone in profile, ratings, sunk cost in account reputation)
picks.why: Spec-textbook for thin-client use: Gen 10 + 16GB + Wi-Fi 6 + 14" Latitude in BKK. Kaidee's reply culture beats FB by ~3×.
picks.risk: no shop tag — verify response time before driving to Lat Phrao.

picks.title: HP Pavilion Ryzen 5 (Series 5) Radeon 16GB 512GB M.2 PCIe 15.6" FHD
picks.shop_signal: JUST_LISTED — newest in pool, seller still actively engaged
picks.why: Biggest screen (15.6" FHD) in fresh pool. Ryzen 5 + 16GB + 512GB at ฿7,999. 'Just listed' = high reply probability.
picks.risk: Ryzen 5 'Series 5' is ambiguous — could be old (4500U) or new (7530U). Confirm exact CPU model. Pavilion is consumer chassis.

picks.title: Asus Vivobook 14X M1404F Ryzen 5 7520U 16GB 512GB M.2 14" FHD
picks.why: Newest CPU in pool by far — Ryzen 5 7520U is 2023 silicon (TSMC 6nm), better battery efficiency than any Intel option here. 16GB + 512GB + 14" FHD at ฿6,490 is excellent.
picks.risk: seller adds '(อ่านก่อนครับ)' = 'read before buying' = there's a defect disclosed. Ask what.

picks.title: Lenovo ThinkPad T490 i5 Gen 8 16GB 250GB Touchscreen
picks.why: ThinkPad T-series build quality + 16GB + touchscreen at ฿6,890. Pathum Thani = 30min drive from BKK center.
picks.risk: Gen 8 is older than batch-1 #6 ghosted T490 — but ฿610 cheaper for same spec + adds touchscreen.

picks.title: Dell Latitude 5490 i5-7300U 16GB 256GB SSD 14" Touchscreen
picks.why: Latitude 5490 with touchscreen variant — rare in this band. Samut Prakan = adjacent to BKK.
picks.risk: i5-7300U is Gen 7 (older than ghosted batch-1 5490s which were Gen 8). Touchscreen adds value but the spec is a step back. Verify the chip.

picks.title: Lenovo ThinkBook 14 i3 Gen11 16GB SSD+HDD backlit-keyboard fingerprint
picks.why: Gen 11 i3 is faster than Gen 8 i5 in single-thread. Plus backlit keyboard + fingerprint sensor + dual storage at ฿6,900 in BKK.
picks.risk: i3 = 2 cores 4 threads. Fine for thin-client; underpowered if Tabby ever needs more.

picks.title: Dell Latitude 3480 i7 Gen 7 16GB 256GB GPU 2GB 14" LED
picks.why: i7 + dGPU 2GB at ฿7,900 — only fresh listing with discrete GPU under budget.
picks.risk: Gen 7 is old (2017). Si Racha = 1.5h drive from BKK; verify shipping if not pickup.

picks.title: Lenovo ThinkPad X13 Core i5 Gen 11 16GB 512GB 13.3" FHD
picks.why: X13 ultrabook + Gen 11 + 16GB + 512GB at exactly ฿8k. Replaces ghosted batch-1 #12 (X13 Gen1 Ryzen) with Intel Gen 11 alternative.
picks.risk: same shipping caveat as #2 (Ban Rakat = Yala province).

picks.title: Lenovo ThinkPad X13 Gen 1 i5 16GB 512GB SSD
picks.why: Stretch budget by ฿500 → premium business ultrabook at the edge.

picks.title: Dell Latitude 5290 2-in-1 SIM-card touchscreen+pen
picks.shop_signal: VERIFIED_SELLER — Kaidee 'ผู้ขายที่ยืนยันตัวตนแล้ว' badge
picks.why: Convertible 2-in-1 with cellular SIM + touch + pen at ฿6,500 in central BKK. Verified seller = strong reply signal.
picks.risk: 12.5" screen is smaller than thin-client target. RAM not stated — must ask. Older Gen 8.

picks.title: Dell Latitude 5430 Chromebook i5 Gen 12 16GB
picks.why: Newest CPU in entire pool — Gen 12 (Alder Lake). 16GB + business chassis + price-cut at ฿7,900 in BKK.
picks.risk: ChromeOS — not Windows. Tabby's WSL workflow assumes Windows host with SSH. Chromebook can run Linux apps + SSH but workflow is different. SKIP unless ChromeOS is acceptable.

picks.title: HP Notebook i5 16GB
picks.shop_signal: VERIFIED_SELLER — Kaidee 'ผู้ขายที่ยืนยันตัวตนแล้ว' badge
picks.why: Cheapest 16GB in entire fresh pool. If Tabby just wants minimum-viable, this is the floor.
picks.risk: 120km from BKK, ships only. CPU model + screen + SSD all unspec'd in title — must ask for full spec sheet before committing.

picks.title: Lenovo i5 Gen 10 16GB 256GB SSD
picks.risk: model not specified in title (could be IdeaPad budget line). Chonburi = 1.5h drive.

explicit_skip_list.title: Mac 21.5 i5 ram16
explicit_skip_list.reason: DESKTOP iMac, not a laptop. Photo-only listings without 'laptop' in title slip through 16GB filter.

explicit_skip_list.title: COD 2025 Founder Pentium 16GB 512GB 15.6"
explicit_skip_list.reason: FRAUD-BAIT spec — Pentium with 16GB RAM is bait, 'Founder' is generic Chinese drop-ship brand. ฿4-6k = below cost-of-real-laptop. SKIP.

explicit_skip_list.title: Lenovo Legion i5 GTX 1050 16GB
explicit_skip_list.reason: carried over from batch-1 ghosted scrape (Legion gaming, not thin-client class)

explicit_skip_list.title: HP Pavilion x360 14-dy0121TU i5-1135G7 16GB
explicit_skip_list.reason: ❤️‍🔥มีตำหนิ❤️‍🔥 = HAS DEFECT (seller-disclosed). Ask what before committing.

fraud_watch: No new MacBook Air M1 listings under ฿7k this round — fraud listings rotate. If one appears, apply same rule as batch 1 (50%-under-Mac2Hand-floor = avoid).
shop_response_rate_hypothesis: Bulk reseller ('8 เครื่อง' style): expect reply within 4 hours business hours
Warranty-bearing private seller (6-month etc): expect reply within 12 hours
Kaidee verified seller: expect reply within 8 hours (LINE/phone in profile)
Just-listed FB: expect reply within 24 hours while listing is fresh
Plain FB private listing >7 days old: expect <30% reply rate (matches batch-1 outcome)
